answer: Because the pigment decay is applied at each close, the violet audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 33% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the forge fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 22 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
